answer: Use a serialized work-slot auction. Each identity needs a unique slot won at the clearing price and a task deposit forfeited on failed cross-checks; a clone cannot reuse timber receipts. Payouts are capped below slot price plus expected forfeiture, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV, and the zenith price resets daily. A failed audit locks that identity's inlet address, forcing a new deposit and slot purchase.
